title: There is no detailed picture of the world in the brain

statements.text: There is no re-presentation of the world inside the brain: the only pictorial version required is the real outside one. Dreams, hallucinations and imagery appear pictorial, but that does not show the brain contains pictures of the detailed environment.

sources.quote: the only pictorial or 3D version required is the real outside version
does not provide evidence in favor of the view that the brain contains pictures of the detailed environment
